column6: M-802 detail C1 (AHU-1 CONTROLS) and the AHU-1 (VAV SYSTEM) sequence: supply fan VFD on duct static pressure with trim and respond polling the VAV boxes; one outdoor air damper modulated to hold the measured outdoor airflow (AI4 OUTDOOR AIRFLOW) with a return damper, no economizer, no return or relief fan; chilled water valve on a 55°F supply air setpoint; a return air smoke detector hardwired with an auxiliary DDC signal (BI1 DUCT SMOKE DETECTOR); no freezestat; USDA, not DoD.

M-803 detail A2 (AHU-2 CONTROLS) and the AHU-2 (CONSTANT VOLUME LAB SYSTEM) sequence: 100% outdoor air, the intake damper opening fully (BO1 open/close, BI1 end switch); the unit 'operates as a constant volume system', its VFD holding a TAB static pressure reference and a fixed 50% unoccupied turndown; chilled water valve on a 55°F supply air setpoint; no zone sensor at the unit (the labs' zones are electric duct heaters); supply smoke detector hardwired and monitored (BI DUCT SMOKE DETECTOR); no freezestat.

M-802 detail A1 (CONSTANT VOLUME AIR-COOLED CHILLER PLANT CONTROLS) and the chilled water plant sequence: one air-cooled chiller, primary-only, no isolation valve drawn; enable BO1 and a BACnet interface (MI1 CHILLER INTEGRATION POINTS; the chiller BACnet interface schedule on M-801); flow proven by DP switch BI5; chilled water reset by outdoor air.
